The '''Ogem system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[D'Aelgoth sector/Legends|D'Aelgoth sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]],<ref name="EAOC" /> along the [[D'Aelgoth Trade Route]].<ref name="TEA" /> It contained the planet [[Ogem/Legends|Ogem]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[near-Human]] [[Ogemite/Legends|Ogemite]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="TEA" />
